title.en: 24 cards: Feyenoord, the left side, Rayo on Monday
title.es: 24 tarjetas: Feyenoord, la izquierda, Rayo el lunes

deck.en: UCL, league, transfer, health, tactics, stats, La Masia, club, finances. Headline plus summary is the story.
deck.es: UCL, liga, mercado, salud, tactica, stats, Masia, club, finanzas.

headline.en: Feyenoord at 18:45 on 9 September opens the league phase
headline.es: El Feyenoord a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre abre la fase liga

summary.en: UEFA locked times Saturday. Barcelona host Feyenoord at Camp Nou on 9 September at 18:45 CET. Then Galatasaray away, PSG away, Villa home, Sabah away, City home, Sporting away, Como home. Early slot means less recovery after Liga. Depth is now a calendar problem.
summary.es: La UEFA fijo horarios. Feyenoord el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45. Luego Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting y Como. La plantilla pasa a ser calendario.

headline.en: Eric Garcia serves the Metropolitano red against Feyenoord
headline.es: Eric Garcia cumple la roja del Metropolitano ante el Feyenoord

summary.en: UEFA 63.01 carries a straight red into the next European match. Garcia misses 9 September. Kounde and Xavi Espart cover the right side.
summary.es: El 63.01 arrastra la roja. Garcia se pierde el 9 de septiembre. Kounde y Espart cubren la derecha.

headline.en: Livakovic is in the session. The ficha is the real deal
headline.es: Livakovic esta en la sesion. La ficha es el fichaje de verdad

summary.en: Contract to 2030. He trained with the first team Saturday. Joan Garcia starts. Stay or loan is fair play.
summary.es: Contrato a 2030. El sabado trabajo con el grupo. Joan Garcia es titular. El fair play decide.

headline.en: Rodri is loaded in the gym, not in the full session
headline.es: A Rodri lo cargan en el gimnasio, no en la sesion completa

summary.en: SPORT: he trained apart again on the arrival plan. Minutes against Athletic were the first public look, not a finished load.
summary.es: SPORT: trabajo al margen y gimnasio. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron la primera foto.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Alvarez. The decree is context, not a contract
headline.es: El Atletico no vende a Alvarez. El decreto es contexto, no un contrato

summary.en: Atletico will not open talks. Decree 1006 is legal colour, not a bid. The nine is Raphinha and Ferran until Atletico change the sentence.
summary.es: El Atletico no abre mesa. El decreto 1006 no es una oferta. El nueve sigue siendo Raphinha y Ferran.

headline.en: Rayo on Monday at 21:30, Gavi held out of the last full session
headline.es: Rayo el lunes a las 21:30, Gavi fuera de la ultima sesion completa

summary.en: Two from two. Monday Rayo 21:30. Livakovic in, Gavi not. If the knee tightens, midfield looks thinner than the table.
summary.es: Dos de dos. Lunes Rayo 21:30. Livakovic si, Gavi no.

headline.en: Toni Fernandez to Venezia: cash, sell-on, buy-back
headline.es: Toni Fernandez al Venezia: caja, plusvalia y opcion de vuelta

summary.en: Verbal deal around four million. Romano: 50 percent sell-on and a buy-back. Same lane as Fort and Cortes.
summary.es: Acuerdo verbal cerca de cuatro millones. Romano: 50 por ciento y recompra.

headline.en: Flick is rewriting the press around Raphinha, not around a new nine
headline.es: Flick reescribe la presion con Raphinha, no con un nueve nuevo

summary.en: Without a classic centre-forward, Raphinha is the press reference. Rayo tests those distances on Monday.
summary.es: Sin un nueve clasico, Raphinha es la referencia. El Rayo examina el lunes.

headline.en: Xavi Espart is first team now, shirt 12
headline.es: Xavi Espart ya es primer equipo, dorsal 12

summary.en: Registered with LaLiga off 36. Flick compared him to Lahm. Started Elche at left-back. SER: the blessed August problem.
summary.es: Inscrito con el 12. Titular en Elche de lateral zurdo. SER: el bendito problema de agosto.

headline.en: Balde stays. Minutes are not guaranteed
headline.es: Balde se queda. Los minutos no estan garantizados

summary.en: After Elche he chose to stay until 2028. Cancelo and Espart are ahead on the left.
summary.es: Tras Elche se queda hasta 2028. Cancelo y Espart van por delante.

headline.en: Cancelo is registered. The 1:1 summer is four names
headline.es: Cancelo esta inscrito. El verano 1:1 son cuatro nombres

summary.en: Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo are on the Liga list. Cancelo covers the left Flick would not give Balde in Elche.
summary.es: Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri y Cancelo ya estan en Liga. Cancelo cubre la izquierda.

headline.en: Gordon first start: recoveries and duels, not the final ball
headline.es: Primer once de Gordon: recuperaciones y duelos, no el ultimo pase

summary.en: 80 minutes, 3 recoveries, 5 of 9 duels, 3 dribbles from 3. Fits the press, not yet the scoresheet.
summary.es: 80 minutos, 3 recuperaciones, 5 de 9 duelos, 3 regates de 3. Encaja en la presion, no en el marcador.

headline.en: Adeyemi started the league. Gordon started Athletic
headline.es: Adeyemi arranco la Liga. Gordon arranco el Athletic

summary.en: Gordon did not come to rotate. Adeyemi won Elche. Gordon lasted 80 on Thursday. Only one starts against Rayo.
summary.es: Gordon no vino a rotar. Adeyemi gano Elche. Contra el Rayo solo sale uno.

headline.en: Yamal played 90 against Athletic: seven shots, still no goal
headline.es: Yamal jugo 90 ante el Athletic: siete tiros, sigue sin gol

summary.en: MARCA: 7 shots, 3 on target, 5 chances, 45 completed passes. Flick: genius after three weeks off. Volume is there. Finish is late.
summary.es: MARCA: 7 tiros, 3 a puerta, 5 ocasiones. Hay volumen. Falta el gol.

headline.en: Athletic 2-0: Raphinha and Fermin as the false nine
headline.es: Athletic 2-0: Raphinha y Fermin de falso nueve

summary.en: Simon and two posts stopped a rout. Seven Liga goals, none conceded.
summary.es: Simon y dos palos. Siete a favor, cero en contra.

headline.en: Gavi's knee looks lighter than Elche. He still missed Saturday
headline.es: La rodilla de Gavi parece menos que Elche. No estuvo el sabado

summary.en: First read less serious. He sat Athletic and Saturday. Pedri started. The club can wait a week, not two if Rodri is also managed.
summary.es: Primera lectura menos grave. No jugo el Athletic ni el sabado. Pedri ocupo el sitio.

headline.en: 1:1 paid Gordon 70 plus 10 and Adeyemi 22 plus 7
headline.es: El 1:1 pago a Gordon 70 mas 10 y a Adeyemi 22 mas 7

summary.en: Rodri over 70m. Cancelo on a free. Masia sales this week keep the ratio legal.
summary.es: Rodri mas de 70. Cancelo libre. Las ventas de Masia sostienen el ratio.

headline.en: Joan Garcia is the starter. The rest of the goal line is politics
headline.es: Joan Garcia es el titular. El resto de la porteria es politica

summary.en: Two clean sheets. Ter Stegen at Ajax. Livakovic waits on a ficha. Garcia does not move this month.
summary.es: Dos porterias a cero. Ter Stegen en el Ajax. Garcia no se mueve este mes.

headline.en: Left-back is three names and one start
headline.es: El lateral zurdo son tres nombres y un solo once

summary.en: Espart started Elche. Cancelo late. Balde back and not first choice. Rayo is the next vote.
summary.es: Espart salio en Elche. Cancelo tarde. Balde no es primero. El Rayo vota.

headline.en: Hard week is PSG away then Villa, City still at home
headline.es: La semana dura es el PSG fuera y luego el Villa

summary.en: Galatasaray and Paris on consecutive October away weeks, then Villa and City. Depth is for those nights.
summary.es: Galatasaray y Paris fuera en octubre, luego Villa y City.

headline.en: Fort, Cortes and Fernandez are the Masia cash window
headline.es: Fort, Cortes y Fernandez son la ventana de caja de la Masia

summary.en: Fernandez around four to five million, Cortes 3.5 to Antwerp. Deco sells who Flick will not name.
summary.es: Fernandez cerca de cuatro o cinco, Cortes 3,5 al Amberes.

headline.en: Seven scored, none conceded. Rayo will sit in
headline.es: Siete a favor, cero en contra. El Rayo se cierra

summary.en: Elche 5-0 and Athletic 2-0 are not the same test. Monday 21:30 is where two from two stops being automatic.
summary.es: Elche y Athletic no son el mismo examen. El 21:30 del lunes no es automatico.

headline.en: Flick has the first-season press back. October is the test
headline.es: Flick recupero la presion del primer ano. Octubre es el examen

summary.en: Two Liga nights look like 2024-25. October is Galatasaray and PSG away. Style is not the question. Bodies behind Raphinha, Pedri and Yamal are.
summary.es: Dos noches de Liga como el 24-25. Octubre es Galatasaray y PSG fuera.

headline.en: Flick is managing Yamal minutes after a three-week break
headline.es: Flick gestiona los minutos de Yamal despues de tres semanas libres

summary.en: 60 minutes after Elche, 90 and the post against Athletic. The load is the story. Finishing follows if the jump is planned.
summary.es: 60 minutos tras Elche, 90 y el palo ante el Athletic. La carga es la noticia.
